en.name: Devil's Advocate
en.ability: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
en.flavor: My client, should the objection be overruled, pleads innocent by virtue of the prosecution's non-observance of statute 27.B - incorrect or misleading conjugation of a verb. The fact that nine of the jury died last night is simply prima facie, which is, as Wills vs Thule set precedent for, further reason to acquit.
